messages:
ashton_cs: heads up — AcmeAI just escalated: they say retrieval + reranker quality dropped noticeably after yesterday's reranker rollout. customer ticket #CS-8421. they provided examples where citations are now missing and recall for named entities fell off a cliff.

maria_support: copying the customer excerpt here: "Query: ‘who founded Synapse Therapeutics and what series did they raise in 2022?’ — previously top doc cited a press release; now top doc is a blog that doesn't mention the company founders at all." customer included top-5 doc ids and timestamps.

ashton_cs: timeline: reranker `reranker-v2-beta` was promoted to 100% at ~2026-03-20T14:05Z per deploy-bot. Acme says changes started ~14:30Z.

deploy-bot: deployment update: rollout-id=RL-20260320-77, service=rerankers, from=canary->prod, model=reranker-v2-beta, completed=2026-03-20T14:05:12Z, regions=[us-west-2,eu-west-1].

devon_ml: thanks. can you paste one full repro query + the doc ids and the rerank scores before/after? also need the index snapshot id (embedding index).

maria_support: pasted from customer: Index snapshot `idx-20260319-emb-37`, query text and top-5 ids: D123,D201,D402,D305,D018. They included: expected top1=D123 (press release), after rollout top1=D402 (irrelevant blog). They also attached a small curl they used to test: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -d '{"model":"reranker-v2-beta","query":"who founded Synapse Therapeutics and what series did they raise in 2022?","candidates":["D123","D201","D402","D305","D018"]}'
```

devon_ml: ok. initial hypothesis: reranker-v2 changed tokenization/CLS pooling or training labels (different distillation target) which can reorder long-tail entity queries. need to compare scores on our held-out eval set (MRR, recall@1/5) and run the customer's query through both v1.9 and v2 to compare logits.

kai_eng: I pulled logs for RL-20260320-77. Canary traffic was 5% for ~2h then 100% at 14:05. No errors in infra, latency stable. No config changes to retrieval ancestor (embedding service) in that rollout.

olga_sre: infra note: there was a minor rolling restart of embedding-service in us-west-2 at 13:58 but it completed before the reranker promote. embedding-service reports index `idx-20260319-emb-37` served fine.

devon_ml: can we reproduce locally with that index snapshot? product_qa, can you run a quick batch of the customer's failing query set (they gave ~120 queries) against both reranker-v1.9 and reranker-v2-beta and post MRR/recall?

product_qa: starting that now. will post numbers in ~25m.

ashton_cs: customer also reported that some citations used to include line-level evidence snippets, now the reranker is surfacing longer but less grounded docs. they suspect a weights/regression.

devon_ml: two things to check quickly: 1) normalization change (embedding L2 norm or score scaling) — if v2 applies temperature or different score calibration it can demote documents with high lexical overlap but low semantic salience; 2) training data drift — v2 was trained with more user-CTR labels which may bias toward clickbait.

kai_eng: workaround option — we can rollback RL-20260320-77 to reranker-v1.9 in a controlled manner (instantiate canary with 10% routing to v1.9 for the affected orgs using the routing policy). I can prepare a rollback patch to be approved.

maria_support: customer asked for ETA on fix and whether we can revert. they are blocking an internal launch.

devon_ml: immediate actions: (A) product_qa to run eval and attach per-query delta, (B) I'll run a debug job to log reranker pairwise scores for top-100 candidates for 50 sample queries including the Acme set, (C) check the training config diff between v1.9 and v2-beta (label source, loss weights, tokenization).

product_qa: results: MRR@5 v1.9 = 0.68, v2-beta = 0.55 on Acme sample set; recall@1 dropped from 0.42 -> 0.23. attaching CSV to ticket. (link omitted)

devon_ml: confirmed substantial reg. I'm seeing consistent score inversions on queries that rely on exact entity mentions. v2 seems to de-emphasize lexical match.

ashton_cs: customer wants immediate rollback. can we ask eng to apply org-scoped rollback so only Acme sees v1.9 while we investigate?

kai_eng: yes. I'll file an emergency rollout-change PR and set routing override for org_id=acme-128 to route 100% to v1.9. doing it now. will ping when live.

deploy-bot: routing change applied: override-rule=org:acme-128 -> reranker-v1.9, rollout-id=RL-20260320-77-RB, applied=2026-03-20T15:02:04Z.

maria_support: Acme confirmed initial checks show recall restored on a handful of queries. they said they can continue with rollback as immediate mitigation. thanks.

devon_ml: next steps: full diff of training/label pipeline due EOD today, assemble a longer A/B with human eval on grounding/citation fidelity, and add regression tests (synthetic entity queries) to CI to prevent future regressions.

ashton_cs: assigning owners: devon_ml -> root cause analysis, product_qa -> extended eval + dataset, kai_eng -> ensure rollback guardrails + safe rollout plan, maria_support -> customer comms and ticket update.

olga_sre: logging note — add a sampling hook to capture reranker input/output for 0.5% of prod queries for 48h for postmortem (sanitized). I can add the hook if approved.

ashton_cs: approved. please redact PII if any.

maria_support: I'll update ticket CS-8421: mitigation applied (org-scoped rollback), ETA for RCA and long-term fix: 72h. customer asks for a short postmortem after RCA.

devon_ml: I'll prioritize model config roll-forward that retains lexical matching features and run A/B on the held-out queries. will post updates here.

ashton_cs: thanks everyone — keep thread updated. if we surface any other customers, escalate immediately. :white_check_mark:
